title.en: In the Bleak Mid-Winter (A Christmas Carol)
title.zh: 在萧瑟的隆冬（圣诞颂歌）

edition.en: Poems, author’s edition revised and enlarged (Boston, 1876, reprinted 1906), on Project Gutenberg (eBook 19188), where it is titled “A Christmas Carol”
edition.zh: 据古登堡计划电子书 19188 所录作者修订增补版《诗集》（波士顿，1876 年，1906 年重印），题作《圣诞颂歌》

basis.en: First published in 1872; the author died in 1894.
basis.zh: 1872 年首次发表；作者卒于 1894 年。

note.en: Christina Rossetti published this as “A Christmas Carol” in 1872; set to music by Gustav Holst in 1906, it became one of the best-loved carols in English. The first stanza is pure snow, “snow on snow”, and the last is a question anyone can answer: what can I give, poor as I am.
note.zh: 克里斯蒂娜·罗塞蒂 1872 年以《圣诞颂歌》为题发表这首诗；1906 年古斯塔夫·霍尔斯特为它谱曲后，它成了英语里最受喜爱的颂歌之一。第一节全是雪，“雪落在雪上”，最后一节是一个谁都能回答的问题：我这样贫穷，能献上什么。

excerpt.orig:
Snow had fallen, snow on snow,
Snow on snow,
excerpt.en:
Snow had fallen, snow on snow,
Snow on snow,
excerpt.zh:
雪落下了，雪落在雪上，
雪落在雪上，
